title: Generating the whole answer, token by token
note: text = subtitles; say = spelled for the voice. Numbers from brain3d/trace.json and build/data/generation_*.json (capture_next_gen.py).

blocks.text: We joins the end of the text. The input is now 101 tokens, and the pass runs again, for token number two.
blocks.say: We joins the end of the text. The input is now one hundred and one tokens, and the pass runs again, for token number two.

blocks.text: Does the model redo all 101 columns? No. A position only looks back, never forward. So adding We changes nothing in the 100 columns before it.
blocks.say: Does the model redo all one hundred and one columns? No. A position only looks back, never forward. So adding We changes nothing in the one hundred columns before it.

blocks.text: Their keys and values, in all 24 blocks, are already computed, so the model keeps them: the KV cache. 256 numbers per position, per block. 614,400 for Emma's prompt.
blocks.say: Their keys and values, in all twenty-four blocks, are already computed, so the model keeps them: the K V cache. Two hundred and fifty-six numbers per position, per block. Six hundred and fourteen thousand, four hundred for Emma's prompt.

blocks.text: So each new token needs just one new column, climbing the 24 blocks. But in every block, its query still reads the keys and values of all 101 positions, its own included.
blocks.say: So each new token needs just one new column, climbing the twenty-four blocks. But in every block, its query still reads the keys and values of all one hundred and one positions, its own included.

blocks.text: Out comes currently, at 48 percent. Its keys and values join the cache, and the next column climbs. Have: 80 percent. A space: 52.
blocks.say: Out comes currently, at forty-eight percent. Its keys and values join the cache, and the next column climbs. Have: eighty percent. A space: fifty-two.

blocks.text: Then the number. The first digit is one, at just 34 percent. Two had 21. Look inside: blocks 21 and 22 lean to four. Block 23 says five. Only block 24 settles on one. Then zero, 32 percent. And zero, 54.
blocks.say: Then the number. The first digit is one, at just thirty-four percent. Two had twenty-one. Look inside: blocks twenty-one and twenty-two lean to four. Block twenty-three says five. Only block twenty-four settles on one. Then zero, thirty-two percent. And zero, fifty-four.

blocks.text: City. E-bike. Battery packs. Available in our Manchester stores. A full stop. Then a special token, im_end, at 84 percent. It means: stop. Twenty tokens, twenty passes.
blocks.say: City. E-bike. Battery packs. Available in our Manchester stores. A full stop. Then a special token, im end, at eighty-four percent. It means: stop. Twenty tokens, twenty passes.

blocks.text: Sample five more runs at temperature 0.7, and the bets land differently. 300. 150. Over 1,000. 50. 15. Ledgerline says 5,400.
blocks.say: Sample five more runs at temperature zero point seven, and the bets land differently. Three hundred. One hundred and fifty. Over one thousand. Fifty. Fifteen. Ledgerline says five thousand four hundred.

blocks.text: Every token was a bet, made by the same machine, run once per token. And every bet came from its weights: 494 million numbers. Where did they come from?
blocks.say: Every token was a bet, made by the same machine, run once per token. And every bet came from its weights: four hundred and ninety-four million numbers. Where did they come from?
